annotations.text:
The call carries the queue button.

When today's call IS "send the drafts", there is no separate drafts section — that is how three copies of one instruction became one card. Every other card is a different kind of move: earn, decide, build, fix.

One draft at a time, message visible.

A list of 43 is a decision about 43 things, which is why 45 of 54 never left. This is a decision about one, ten times.

Every bar opens the businesses at that stage.

That is where the Pipeline tab went — the funnel stops being decoration and becomes the navigation.

"Where the opening is" is the old "What they keep asking for", renamed to what it actually measures.

Sorted by how long each has waited, not by a score that reads 100% for everything.

Eleven days is the number that makes you send.
